messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: elevated 5xx error rate on inference-gateway-us-east-1, ~18% 5xx over last 3m, spike in model-runner OOM / segfaults. Paging: Ben (oncall).
Ben (oncall): Ack. I'm on it — taking pager. Starting quick triage.
Ben (oncall): Initial graphs show tail latency + error surge coincident with kernel restarts on node pool `irun-prod-01`.
Alice (prod-eng): Noted. Any customer-facing impact? Erin, any active support tickets?
Erin (support): Yes — two customers (acme-inc, zipstream) reporting 502/timeout errors in the last 5m. CS is escalating.
Carol (SRE): Attaching recent logs:
```
[2026-03-17T02:03:10Z] model-runner[pid=4123]: segfault at 0x0 ip=0x7f9b3... rsp=0x7ffd..
[2026-03-17T02:03:10Z] kernel: GPU watchdog reset on GPU0, process model-runner (oom?)
[2026-03-17T02:04:05Z] gateway: 502 upstream read timeout from irun-prod-01:4500
```
Ben (oncall): Thanks. Tentative hypothesis: a new quant-attention kernel rollout yesterday might be unstable on long-context workloads.
Dave (infra): Confirmed recent kernel bump on that pool at 2026-03-16T23:40:00Z. Rolling back is an option.
Alice (prod-eng): Immediate mitigations: 1) Route traffic away from irun-prod-01 pool to fallback pool `irun-prod-02` (no quant kernel). 2) Disable quant kernel variant for affected model family. 3) Increase retries at gateway for short window.
Ben (oncall): I'm running the reroute now: `svc route set inference-gateway --exclude-pool irun-prod-01 --reason "live 5xx"`
DevOpsBot: Command accepted. Routing change started (approx 30s propagation).
Ben (oncall): Observing drop in 5xx to ~6% after reroute, tail latency improving. Still seeing isolated segfaults on a few nodes.
Frank (reliability): Recommend cordoning the most erroring instances and force-draining their tasks to avoid noisy neighbors.
Dave (infra): Cordoning nodes n-213, n-214, n-219. Evicting pods with graceful drain.
Carol (SRE): Captured coredumps from n-213 and collected perf traces. Uploading to /tmp/incident/5100009999/trace.tar.gz
Alice (prod-eng): Good. Signal to rollback kernel to previous stable at 2026-03-16T22:55:00Z on that pool. Dave, can you trigger a rollback?
Dave (infra): Rolling back kernel on irun-prod-01 now. ETA 5m for all nodes to be back to previous runtime.
Erin (support): Notifying affected customers: sending a short note that we saw elevated errors, mitigation in progress, ETA 30m for full recovery.
Ben (oncall): Updating severity to Sev2 due to multiple paying customers impacted. Creating post-incident channel #postmortem-5100009999.
Frank (reliability): Post-mitigation checklist: validate KV cache consistency, rerun evictions with caching warmed, run regression prompts against canary traffic.
Carol (SRE): After rollback complete: segfaults ceased on cordoned nodes, error rate now stable at ~1.2%. Gateway timeouts reduced.
Alice (prod-eng): Next actions: capture full regression test, pin model->runner kernel matrix, add defensive OOM cgroup for model-runner, and schedule a follow-up RCA.
Ben (oncall): Handoff: I need to go offline in 30m. Carol, please take overnight lead and own the RCA doc and follow-ups. Carol?
Carol (SRE): I will take it. I'll post the initial RCA draft in #postmortem-5100009999 and coordinate with Prod Eng for kernel gating.
Ben (oncall): Thanks team. Summary for handoff: cause = unstable quant-attention kernel rollout causing OOM/segfault on long-context inference; mitigation = immediate traffic reroute, node cordon/drain, kernel rollback; customer impact = short window (~15-35m) of elevated 5xx affecting two known customers; next steps = RCA, add canary gating, defensive cgroups, and improved automated rollback on kernel telemetry.
Erin (support): I'll stitch timeline and customer communications into the postmortem.
DevOpsBot: Incident channel created: #postmortem-5100009999. Pager closed for this incident at 5100010200.
Ben (oncall): Closing thread from primary oncall. Carol taking over for follow-ups. Good work everyone. :thumbsup:
